analysis.note: `uic` (added by #164) makes the transient start from a physically realizable initial condition -- every node at 0, EN low, the block disabled -- and power up through its own soft-start ramp when this testbench's EN edge arrives at 100us, rather than from an unconstrained ngspice operating-point solve. Without it (and with the pre-#164 DC-high EN), the `.op` that seeds the transient has no initial condition at all, and 11 of these same 200 mismatch draws settled on a spurious branch of `sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po`'s voltage-coefficient expression -- whose modelled resistance goes NEGATIVE above ~1.35kV (L=180um, the divider legs) and ~475V (L=52um, R_CZ), measured -- leaving VOUT pinned at VIN for the whole 3ms with FB/N_FBB/EA_CZ at 650V-1e15V. See design/README.md "#164" for the characterization and the four-variant screen that selected this initial condition; the 185 samples that already regulated are bit-identical before and after.

measurements.name: vout_ss
measurements.note: Steady-state VOUT, averaged over the settled tail (2.5ms-3ms of a 3ms transient) of a fixed-1mA-load, VIN=3.3V/27C/tt_mm operating point, reached by powering the block up from its disabled state (EN edge at 100us, `uic`; see mc_analysis.note and #164) rather than from an unconstrained operating-point solve. Ratified bound: spec/target-spec.md "Output" row, 1.8V +-2% (ratified by issue #1 / DR-006).
measurements.spice: .meas tran vout_ss avg v(vout) from=2.5m to=3m
